c6:gaziantep house.aciklama: This is a museum about the Whirling Dervishes. It's housed in a fine mansion, and shows displays. It is part of a mosque's "külliye" (Islamic-Ottoman social complex centered around a mosque). It was built in the 17th century. The Mevlevi Lodge Monastery is entered via a courtyard which opens off the courtyard of the mosque. Elsewhere I found it probably belonged to the Tekke Mosque, The mosque was built in 1638 by a Turkmen landowner, Mustafa Aga.

It was built in the 17th century. The Mevlevi Lodge Monastery is entered via a courtyard which opens off the courtyard of the mosque. Elsewhere I found it probably belonged to the Tekke Mosque, The mosque was built in 1638 by a Turkmen landowner, Mustafa Aga.

c6:anatolian garden.baslik: File:Museum of Anatolian Civilizations Hittite Replica of the Fasıllar Monument in 2004 02.jpg
c6:anatolian garden.aciklama: In a village, Fasıllar, a monument from the 13th century BC that was never finished lies on a hill. It’s Turkish name is “Kurt Beşiği” (Wolf's Cradle), although it has nothing to do with wolves. A well-carved Storm God stands with his left leg on the head of the Mountain God. Thew latter stands between two lions. It is one block of rock of about 70 tons, its height is 8 meters and its width is 2.75 meters. A replica stands in the garden of the Ankara museum.

c6:the land of legends.aciklama: تعتبر أرض الأساطير من أبرز معالم السياحة في أنطاليا، ويمتد على مساحة تصل إلى 639 ألف متر مربع في مدينة أنطاليا، وقد تم افتتاحه في العام 2016، ويضم أرض الأساطير أنطاليا مختلف المرافق الترفيهية وخدمات الضيافة الفاخرة، وفندقاً 5 نجوم مصمماً للأطفال خصوصاً، ومرافق ترفيهية لا يوجد لها مثيل على مستوى العالم. ويشكل أرض الأساطير في أنطاليا إضافة إلى حديقتها الخيالية ومدينتها المائية مركزاً ترفيهياً متكاملاً، واستطاعت أن تكون الوجهة الأولى في مدينة أنطاليا استقبالاً للسياح.

Termessos was a Pisidian city built at an altitude of more than 1000 meters at the south-west side of the mountain Solymos (modern day Güllük Dağı) in the Taurus Mountains (modern day Antalya province, Turkey). It lies 30 kilometres to the north-west of Antalya. It was founded on a natural platform on top of Güllük Dağı, soaring to a height of 1.665 metres from among the surrounding travertine mountains of Antalya, which average only 200 metres above sea level.

c6:lpg gas pump.aciklama: LPG Bullets The Bullets, named because of their shape stored Liquefied Petroleum Gases. LPG is the generic name for commercial Propane and commercial Butane. The two smaller vessels V1085 and V1086 stored Propane and were designated as emergency vaporisers for the Refinery Fuel Gas Main. V1092 and V1093 stored a combination of Butane and Propane which was pumped to process units to be separated. V1094 the furthest of the vessels was converted to be a buffer vessel for the Refinery Fuel Gas Main.

c6:red tower alanya historical tower.aciklama: The Kizil Kule (Red Tower) The octagonal shaped building that's the symbol of the city is a work by Selcuks of the 13th century. c6:kemer municipality.aciklama: The photograph depicts a wide shot and the structural design of the Višnjica spring in Dabrica. In the foreground is a massive stone vault (volt), a traditional architectural element built from hewn stone to protect the spring from sunlight, contamination, and external elements. This type of covering allowed for the preservation of lower water temperatures and quality during summer months. Connected concrete troughs forming a functional unit for water distribution are also visible.

This increase is usually caused by technical problems on the road or in the means of transport, other times it is caused by the behavior of drivers on the road. Road safety is often a serious problem both in terms of the number of road victims and the economic cost of these accidents on the Algerian economy. The fight against road safety can be a priority concern of the State and this fight must be waged against the most vulnerable road user

c6:manavgat manavgat coast.aciklama: Side is an ancient Greek city on the southern Mediterranean coast of Turkey, a resort town and one of the best-known classical sites in the country. It lies near Manavgat and the village of Selimiye, 78 km from Antalya in the province of Antalya. It is located on the eastern part of the Pamphylian coast, which lies about 20 km east of the mouth of the Eurymedon River. Today, as in antiquity, the ancient city is situated on a small north-south peninsula about 1 km long and 400 m across.

c6:antalya clouds.baslik: File:Antalya museum Uşak medallion carpet, 16th century carpet 4858.jpg
c6:antalya clouds.aciklama: Uşak medallion carpet, 16th century carpet. It is huge, six or seven meters wide, I'd guess. Uşak (110 km west of Afyon) was one of the most important and renowned carpet centers in Ottoman times (late 15th to 18th century). Rug production is still going on today, but on a lesser level and with altered designs. In the 17th century great quantities of Uşak carpets were made for the royal houses and the Christian churches of Europe. They are named according to their specific design: ‘star’, ‘medal
c6:antalya clouds.nesne: Antalya museum Uşak medallion carpet, 16th century carpet 4858

Powered by a simple but noisy pulsejet that earned it the Allied nicknames of "buzz bomb" and "doodle bug," more than 20,000 were launched at British and continental targets, mostly London and Antwerp, from June 1944 to March 19

c6:mediterranean coastal road.aciklama: Westward view across the buildings above Cala d'Estellencs on the northwestern coast of Mallorca. In the foreground are several traditional Mallorcan-style stone buildings, including the property currently rented as Cala Estellencs House . The Camí de la Mar, one of the two access roads leading down to the cove, passes between the buildings, which are surrounded by retaining walls, stairways and small terraces. Further uphill on the left, another stone house stands on a rocky coastal slope cover

c6:united kingdom flute.aciklama: Flute casts at Donkey Quarry near Broughton in Furness, Cumbria, England. These are excellent turbidite sequence flute casts. Possibly the best exposure in the UK. They are part of the Gawthwaite Formation (425 Ma, Silurian). These are shelf deposits which saw fast flows of sediment settle out into various grades. This is the bottom of a flow which scoured out the seabed (Iapetus) forming these features. They show the bed has been tilted by 90 degrees.

c6:united kingdom flute.aciklama: Flute Casts These knobbly shapes are indicative of turbidites, which are rocks formed by underwater slumps and landslides. The turbulent current carves hollows in the underlying rocks, and the hollows are then filled with sediment. This face is the underside of the flow; the rocks in this quarry have been tilted beyond the vertical. These turbidites are of Silurian age.

Many Turkish cities have an Atatürk Museum, often in a house where the founder of the Turkish Republic stayed at some time, sometimes for just one night. This is the Gaziantep version, for a stay on January 26, 1933, in a house from 1892.

This monument (named ‘Atatürk anıtı’ = Atatürk Memorial) dates from around 1930. Atatürk is portrayed as commander in chief of the Turkish armies. To the left stands a village woman in traditional Türkmen dress, carrying a bouquet of roses. To the right, a militia warrior holds the corner of a carpet; he wears the costume of the local ‘Zeybek’. Zeybeks (or Zeibeks), were irregular militia and guerrilla fighters living in the Aegean Region of the Ottoman Empire from late 17th to early 20th centur

c6:yesiloz.aciklama: Hot Air Ballooning Cappadocia: A must do in Cappadocia is take a balloon ride in order to see the sights from a vantage point like no other. On this 1-hour flight at sunrise you will experience the changing colors and the unique landscapes that scatter the region. Enjoy a unique hot air balloon flight over the fairy chimneys and rock cut churches. This exhilarating experience in Cappadocia is one of the best places around the world to fly with hot air balloons. www.britannica.com/place/Cappadoci
c6:yesiloz.nesne: CAPPADOCIA Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites. World Heritage List. Turkey. Hot Air Ballooning Cappadocia

c6:yesiloz.baslik: File:CAPPADOCIA Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites. World Heritage List. The Fairy Chimneys.jpg
c6:yesiloz.aciklama: THE FAIRY CHIMNEYS In the days before tourism local people called the strange rock cones that surrounded them kales, or 'castles'. Nowadays these amazing structures are usually called peribacalari, or 'fairy chimneys'. They come in an extraordinary range of shapes and sizes but most are tall and phallic-shaped with a cap of harder stone that protects the softer rock underneath from erosion. Eventually these caps fall off, whereupon the wind and rain start to whittle away the cone until eventuall

c6:aksu ministry building.aciklama: It is an artificial lake built 13 kilometers south of Bolu city center. The surface of the lake, whose height is 1217 meters, is 4.5 hectares and its circumference is about 1300 meters. The view of the lake, which is covered with pine, fir, beech, hornbeam and mixed species of trees, is wonderful in every season. On the edge of the lake, which is covered with the extraordinary beauty of nature, there is a cute building, which is the "State Guesthouse" of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

c6:serenity queen.baslik: File:Sacred Serenity, Gunung Kawi Temple in Bali.jpg
c6:serenity queen.aciklama: Gunung Kawi Temple, also known as Gunung Kawi cliff temple, is an enchanting 11th-century temple and funerary complex nestled in the village of Tampaksiring, Bali. This protected archaeological site spans both banks of the Pakerisan River, captivating visitors with its unique location carved into the rock cliffside. Legend has it that Gunung Kawi Temple got its name from the combination of "Gunung" meaning "mountain" and "Kawi" referring to "sculpture," signifying a temple carved on a mountain.
c6:serenity queen.nesne: Sacred Serenity, Gunung Kawi Temple in Bali

The street originates at the City Gates and leads to the ancient temples and houses of the rich citizens of the ancient city. The name Colonnade(d) Avenue can be found in some historical sources.

c6:antalya antalya city center.aciklama: Kaleiçi is the historic city center of Antalya, Turkey. Until modern times, almost the entire city was confined within its walls. It has structures dating from the Roman, Byzantine, Seljuk, Ottoman and modern Turkish republican eras. The Kaleiçi area is located in the centre-eastern portion of the city along the mediterranean coast fronted by the yacht harbour that dates to the Roman era. The name Kaleiçi means "Inside the Kale" or "Inner Kale" (Kale itself means castle or fortress).

c6:antalya antalya city center.aciklama: Kurshunlu Waterfall Nature Park is located in Aksu district of Antalya province, Turkey, 6-7 km to the east of the city center. The park is famous for a waterfall and a variety of plants and animals. It is one of favourite recreational spots for locals and a famous destination for tourists. On the photo the part of the Kurshunlu waterfall, a pond and surrounding plant variety are shown. The photo was captured in June, 2018.

c6:antalya antalya city center.aciklama: Ruins of Pinara, ancient Lycian city in Asia Minor, close to Fethiye, Antalya Province, Turkey. September, 2025. Pinara, PinalePilleñni The city of Pinara is located on the eastern slopes of the South Antikragos Mountains (Baba Dağı) to the east of Fethiye Bay and overlooks the Xanthos Valley. It was built on terraces rising from 330 meters to 715 meters. It is bordered by the cities of Xanthos in the south and Tlos in the northeast. The Lycian name of the city was Pinale (or Pilleñni). c6:aqua fit.aciklama: There will be no clean water highlights the extreme effects of climate change in Eswatini. Droughts have ravaged the country now and again in the past resulting in shortages of water supply and pollution has worsened the situation at hand. Climate change has also caused frequent heatwaves. This remains an eye opener and a strong motivator to society that employing certain efforts towards mitigating the present and future effects of climate change can be proved to be very important.

Japan Expo is a French professional event show on Japanese popular culture, which takes place at the Paris-Nord Villepinte exhibition center every year at the beginning of July, or even at the end of June over a period of four days. It is a cultural event dedicated to manga, video games, anime, but also to martial arts, fashion, music (J-pop, Jrock, traditional), cinema, traditions and cultures, to young artists and creators, to mechanical sport.

c6:london tourism fair.aciklama: I used to volunteer at the museum in the 1990s. London is a city located in Southwestern Ontario, Canada along the Quebec City–Windsor Corridor. The city has a population of 366,151 according to the 2011 Canadian census. c6:natural stone blocks.aciklama: The "Singing Stone" is a block of blue azurite and green malachite, on display at the American Museum of Natural History in New York City. The block weighs about 3,300 kg and contains about 1,500 kg of copper. It was originally collected in 1891 in Brisbee, Arizona, and first exhibited at the 1893 World’s Fair in Chicago. The name derives from the sounds emanating from the stone during changes in humidity.

Banded iron formations, or BIFs, are unusual, dense sedimentary rocks consisting of alternating layers of iron-rich oxides and iron-rich silicates. Most BIFs are Proterozoic in age (although some are Late Archean), and do not form today - they're “extinct”! c6:car inspection turkey.aciklama: Never thaw foods in a garage, basement, car, dishwasher or plastic garbage bag; out on the kitchen counter, outdoors or on the porch. These methods can leave your foods unsafe to eat. There are three safe ways to thaw food: in the refrigerator, in cold water, or in the microwave. It's best to plan ahead for slow, safe thawing in the refrigerator. Small items may defrost overnight; most foods require a day or two and large items like turkeys may take longer, approximately one day for each 5 pound
c6:car inspection turkey.nesne: Food Safety - Cut Waste in Refrigerators (20120106-OC-AMW-0077)

c6:car inspection turkey.aciklama: A quoi reconnaît-on la puissance industrielle d'un pays ? Le degré de développement de sa construction automobile, est un bon indicateur ! Plakias is a village on the south coast of the Greek island of Crete, in the Rethymno Prefecture, about 30 kilometres south of the city of Rethymno. It is part of the municipality Foinikas. It is surrounded by mountains to the north and the Libyan Sea to the south. The former town of fishermen developed in the last few decades into a tourist resort. The first official notice of Plakias was in 1961, when it was mentioned in a census as the permanent home of six fishermen.

c6:classroom.aciklama: Palamuse Parish School's classroom. This 19th century classroom is now a part of a museum that bears the name of writer Oskar Luts , who studied there and wrote the book Kevade about his schooldays. c6:(boş) protest.aciklama: A group of young men forming a black bloc marching during a demonstration in Jakarta , Indonesia , holding flags and a banner. The words on the banner, which are partly hidden, are "BOS BUTUH KA[M]U / KAMU TIDAK BUTUH [B]OS / JARINGAN ANTI-OTORITARIA[N]", which means "The boss needs you / You do not need the boss / Anti-authoritarian network". The black flag with an "A" in a circle in white on it held by a protester in front of the banner is a well-known anarchist symbol .

Dockyard's construction started in 1227, six years later than the Sultan's conquest of the city, near Kizilkule and finished in one year. The Side of the dockyard overlooking the sea and having five cells with arches is 56.5 metres long and it is 44 metres in depth. c6:kızılkule historical tower.aciklama: The Kizil Kule (Red Tower) The octagonal shaped building that's the symbol of the city is a work by Selcuks of the 13th century. Skip's mother Cele opened a women's clothing store on Lincoln Road and later managed an Elizabeth Arden store in Surfside. Skip was an award winning football and baseball player during high school, received a baseball scholarship for the University of M

Aerial photograph of the Recor furniture factory at Hasselt, Belgium, which would close in 2020. Nikon D60 f=55mm f/9 at 1/320s ISO 800. Contrast and colours enhanced using Nikon NX Studio 1.3.2. Perspective corrected and aircraft wing erased using GIMP 2.10.34.

The factory was built by the carriage master Friedrich Johann Melzer, the father of the architect Roman Fedorovich Melzer (1860 -1943, one of the leaders of St. Petersburg modernist style) who arrived from Prussia. The factory became one of the largest enterprises in the city, producing high-quality furniture, and the owner was awarded the title "Supplier of His Imperial Majesty."

c6:furniture factory fire.aciklama: Co-op furniture factory The former Co-op furniture factory in Belmont Row. The archway at the end furthest from the photographer has the inscription "Workpeople and Goods Entrance"!

The tide is out and the receding waters have exposed a vast expanse of beach. Holkham beach consists of many miles of clean golden sands, white sand dunes, mud and shingle patches and an area designated for naturists; there are no beach huts or deck chairs. c6:antalya hair styling.aciklama: Discovered in 1981 in the Gallery of Claudius Peison at the South Bath of Perge. Using two colours marble, black for hair and clothing, white for face, neck and arms. 103 pieces had to be put together during reconstruction. The obvious movement of the figure led to the dance-interpretation. This is a second century copy of an original from the Rococo style of the Hellenistic period. Source: Sculptures of the museum in Antalya (booklet in shop).

c6:recycled art exhibition.aciklama: Artwork “Ser o no Ser” (2012) by Venezuelan artist Honys Torres, an assemblage made with acrylic on canvas and recycled materials, measuring 120 × 120 cm. Through the use of reused objects and materials, the piece offers a critical reflection on social tensions and the fragility of the human condition. This work was awarded 1st Prize in Painting at the XXXII National Art Salon “7 de Diciembre” 2012, held in Maturín, Venezuela.

c6:agricultural field turkey.aciklama: Satellite image of crops growing in Kansas , United States . Healthy, growing crops are green. Corn would be growing into leafy stalks by late June (when this photo was taken). Sorghum , which resembles corn, grows more slowly and would be much smaller and therefore, possibly paler. Wheat is a brilliant gold as harvest occurs in June. Fields of brown have been recently harvested and plowed under or lie fallow for the year. The circular crop fields are a characteristic of center pivot irrigation

c6:amphitheater.aciklama: Amphitheater of the ancient roman city of Italica , today municipality of Santiponce , near Seville, Spain. The amphitheater was built during the reign of emperor Hadrian (117-138) and, with a capacity of 25,000 spectators, was one of the biggest amphitheaters in the Roman Empire. Italica was the first roman city in Hispania and was founded in 206 BC by the great Roman general Publius Cornelius Scipio (later given the nickname Africanus ) to settle his victorious veterans from the Second Punic W

c6:amphitheater.baslik: File:Anfiteatro de Pula, Croacia, 2017-04-16, DD 01-06 PAN.jpg
c6:amphitheater.aciklama: Panoramic view of the interior of the Pula Arena , an amphitheatre located in Pula , Croatia . This Roman edifice was constructed between 27 BC and 68 AD and is among the largest surviving Roman arenas in the world. At the same time, is the best preserved ancient monument in Croatia and the only remaining amphitheater having all four side towers with all three Roman architectural orders entirely preserved. This is a a photo of a cultural heritage in Croatia with ID: Z-863.

c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: Lotto carpets can be recognized by their consistent color combinations and striking design, traceable to sources in Central Asia. In the central field, stylized yellow leaf patterns stand out against a red ground. The border is filled with cartouches on a dark blue background, and a simplified vine meanders along the outermost edge. These vegetal patterns evoke paradise in Islamic contexts. Made primarily for export in the western Turkish center of Ushak between the 1400s and 1600s, Lotto carpet

c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: This rare Ottoman embroidery features a floral bouquet that enriches the field under an elegant arch of gilt-metal thread. Flanked by vines of tulips and irises on a silver-metal-thread ground, vases of tulips and jonquils within cartouches adorn the main border and the well-turned corners, a sign of high quality. c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: Probably the portrait of Abdullah Efendi (1680?–1743). This clergyman of Greek descent was working at the court from 1718 as Shaykh al-Islām and was deposed after the Revolution of 1730. He was exiled, but returned to Istanbul in silence, where he died in 1743. Abdullah owned a large collection of legal and religious documents and was instrumental in the introduction of the printing press in the Ottoman Empire.

c6:title deed document turkey.baslik: File:Carle Vernet - Saddled Arabian Horse in Courtyard - 2008.398 - Cleveland Museum of Art.tif
c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: While his father, Joseph, was known for marine paintings, and his son, Horace, became a celebrated Romantic artist, Carle Vernet excelled in representing battles and animals, especially horses. Vernet was an expert rider himself, and in his pictures he precisely described various breeds and horse dressings. Although the artist never traveled further from France than Italy, his drawing of an Arabian horse contains elements that make it seem as if he observed the animal in its native environment.

c6:mediterranean sea earthquake map.aciklama: It was built between 1396 and 1421 by the Grand Master Philibert de Naillac before the development of the cannons on the mole east of the Gate of Saint Paul that closes the commercial harbour. It had a square shape like many other medieval towers and was 46 m (145 ft.) high. It was the terminal of the wall belt facing the harbour and was used as a watch tower. It was severely damaged during the earthquakes of 19th century and was demolished by the Ottoman administration [Wikipedia.org]

c6:antalya environment.aciklama: In Olympos Beydağları National Park, there is a profusion of thriving reeds. These elongated plants, characterized by their height and slimness, grow closely together in lush groups throughout the park's wetland regions, including marshes, rivers, and lakes. The reeds play a crucial role in the park's ecosystem by offering a habitat and protective covering for a diverse range of birds, insects, and aquatic creatures. c6:antalya environment.baslik: File:River in Olympos Beydağları National Park.jpg
c6:antalya environment.aciklama: The surviving remnants of Olympos, which can be found today, are primarily situated at the estuary of a fast-moving river that flows from east to west, ultimately reaching the sea. On both sides of the river, there are harbors, with the ancient city being divided by a canal that contained the river's course. The canal served as a pier on both sides, connected by a bridge. Presently, one pillar of the bridge remains intact, standing in its original location.

c6:antalya environment.baslik: File:Tree in Olympos Beydağları National Park.jpg
c6:antalya environment.aciklama: Olympos National Park boasts a wide range of magnificent trees that enhance the scenery with their inherent splendor. The forested regions are primarily dominated by towering evergreen trees like majestic pines and firs, whose impressive heights allow their lofty tops to extend skyward. These coniferous trees create a lush green covering, forming a vibrant canopy that provides shade and refuge for the park's diverse plant and animal life.

c6:antalya necropolis museum.aciklama: Medaillon Sarcophagus. Marble L: 191 cm. H: 78 cm. Roman Period, 2nd century A.D. Perge, Western Necropolis - A.380 The gable-shaped lid contains floral akroterion on the corners and an omphalos in the pediment. The antefixes at the end of the carved roof tiles have lion-heads. Each of the four sides of this sarchophagus has a carved Medusa head in a medallion; those on the long sides of the tomb are supported by Nikai at one side and by Erotes on the other. c6:antalya necropolis museum.aciklama: ARIADNE ON THE SARCOPHAGUS LID Marble L: 274 cm. W: 131 cm. H: 120 cm. Roman Period 2nd century A.D. Perge Found in the Western Necropolis in 1995. Only the lid of this superbly carved large sarcophagus has been found to date. It has Ariadne, the wife of Dionysos, represented asleep upon it, with the trace of a lizard carved by her feet. The face was damaged during its illegal excavation. Source: pdf of the museum found on the internet.

Perge, Western Necropolis Sarcophagus carrying a cline scene upon the lid. As recorded in the inscription on the lid, Aurelia Botiane Demetria is reclining with her husband. The husband's head isn't carved in detail, but just blocked in. The figures carved between the columns on the body of the sarcophagus represent philosophy, wisdom etc. On the back of the sarcophagus are several carved scenes

c6:water infrastructure maintenance.baslik: File:Overhead water tank rural Raichur Karnataka India water tower.jpg
c6:water infrastructure maintenance.aciklama: Overhead water tank (water tower) in a village in Raichur district, Karnataka, India. The structure consists of a reinforced concrete storage tank elevated on columns, with a spiral staircase for access and maintenance. Such water towers are used in rural water supply systems to store water and distribute it through gravity-fed pipelines. These systems are common in villages across India, ensuring reliable domestic water supply in areas where groundwater or piped water infrastructure is limited

The night after the October 1st mass shooting in Las Vegas, scouts from Las Vegas Area Council's Boyscouts Troop 430 gathered bottled water and food to donate to officers of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department. Officers were working extended shifts and needed snacks and water to keep them going. On October 3rd, A truck and trailer load of non-perishables was dropped off at LVMPD Northwest Area Command.

c6:antalya hotels.aciklama: يتألف الفندق من 320 وحدة سكنية. يتم الترحيب بالضيوف في بهو الإستقبال حيث يتواجد مكتب خدمات لإتمام إجراءات الوصول أو المغادرة. يؤمن المصعد الوصول إلى الطوابق العليا بكل راحة. يساهم توافر الخدمات والتجهيزات مثل شماعة ملابس وخزنة ومكتب صرافة وصراف آلي في تأمين إقامة مريحة. تتوفر في الأماكن العامة إمكانية الإتصال بالإنترنت السلكي (مقابل دفع رسوم إضافية) والإنترنت اللاسلكي. يحتوي الفندق فيما يخص مرافق تقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات على مطعم وقاعة طعام وصالة فطور ومقهى وبار. هناك سوبرماركت لتأمين الاحتياجات

c6:taurus mountains documentary.aciklama: Bagdad-Bahn, "Münster 4827", 13. April 1917. There was a section of the Baghdadbahn in the Taurus Mountains which was extremely difficult to build, with several tunnels whose construction caused delays. To speed up construction, the enginners decided to lay 600 mm gauge track through the unfinished section to allow construction on the section onward to proceed. This also included locomotives and rolling stock, which were moved across the section in a semi-dismantled state on transporter wagons.

c6:good party.aciklama: ​1948年，蒋介石在美国大选中支持杜威。北平一支为杜威助威的队伍共20多人，抬着贴有杜威画像的大象（象征共和党），举着写有“杜威好运”“Good_Luck_Dewey”的横额、旗子，敲锣打鼓，由故宫神武门出发向东，沿紫禁城外向南，经南池子、长安左门等处后，回故宫午门东侧，沿紫禁城外向北回到神武门。据说这些人是从杠房（在丧事中抬棺材的机构）雇来，大象是裱糊铺（为丧事制作用来焚烧的纸人纸马的机构）扎的。当时正值国共内战白热化，这出闹剧并未引发任何关注。

c6:crowded city street.aciklama: Crowded cable car descending Powell Street. The San Francisco cable car system is the world's last manually operated cable car system and an icon of the city of San Francisco. While the cable cars are used to a certain extent by commuters, the vast majority of the millions of passengers who use the system every year are tourists and the wait to get on can often reach two hours or more. They are among the most significant tourist attractions in the city.

c6:polsan.aciklama: Fiskebåten GG 195 Normy från Hälsö som hittade den minsprängda u-båten Ulven på position latitud nord 57 grader 45,05 minuter och longitud ost 11 grader 26,8 minuter, den 5 maj 1943 efter tre veckors intensivt sökande sydväst Stora Pölsan i Göteborgs norra skärgård.

c6:polsan.baslik: File:Draken I class submarine Ulven, Scale model.jpg
c6:polsan.aciklama: ULVEN sjösattes 1930 och tjänstgjorde i Svenska Flottan till 1943 då hon 15 april minsprängdes under en övning sydväst om Stora Pölsan utanför Göteborgs norra skärgård. Efter tre veckors sökande hittade man ULVEN den 5 maj och under sommaren bärgades ubåten med de 33 omkomna besättningsmännen ombord. Händelsen har gått tilll eftervärlden som Ulvenkatastrofen. Från originalbåten ULVEN har Sjöhistoriska museet bland annat även en telefonboj, livboj, stävmärken och namnplåt, liksom några personliga
c6:polsan.nesne: Draken I class submarine Ulven, Scale model

c6:polsan.aciklama: HMS Ulven var en ubåt i Draken -klass som var i tjänst i svenska flottan mellan åren 1931 och 1943. Den ingick tillsammans med ubåtarna HMS Gripen (1928) och HMS Draken (1926) i Göteborgseskadern. Under övning i uläge sprängdes ubåten, troligen av en tysk mina, den 15 april 1943 i den så kallade Ulvenkatastrofen. Hela besättningen på 33 man omkom. Först efter 19 dagar kunde en fiskebåt lokalisera HMS Ulven på 52 meters djup sydväst om ön Stora Pölsan och efter ytterligare tre månader bärgades vr

Shortly after, the truck exploded, killing some 58 people and some 20 more in the days thereafter. The accident received global media coverage.

c6:eco friendly food basket.aciklama: The farms that are springing up today and not the mom-and-pop farms of yore, which grew out of subsistence farming. The ones of today are niche farms, which each fill a special need. Many sell garden plants and nursery stock. However, unlike most older nurseries, today’s garden centers stock not only foundation planting, annuals, and perennials, but also exotic specimens, architectural elements, such as gates and ponds, and a host of eco-friendly products. Oh, yes, and most also have gift items.

In 1999 , together with his wife – Gabriela Pewińska-Jaśniewicz – he founded Teatr z Polski 6 and staged 17 monodramas.

c6:turkish small business shop.aciklama: From the Wikipedia article: In 1876, brothers Haci Ibrahim and Haci Sadik established a boza shop in the Istanbul district of Vefa, close to the then center of entertainment, Direklerarası. This boza, with its thick consistency and tart flavor, became famous throughout the city, and is the only boza shop dating from that period still in business today. The firm is now run by Haci Sadik and Haci Ibrahim's great-great-grandchildren.

Burnt Balls, New Forest This area of open heath really is called Burnt Balls. Locally "Balls" are sandy knolls in the landscape (as in nearby Sandy Balls), and perhaps "burnt" comes from an instance of a heath fire. The trees in the distance on the left are part of Pitts Wood Inclosure.

c6:burnt forest trees.baslik: File:Regeneration on burnt heathland on Yew Tree Heath, New Forest - geograph.org.uk - 164233.jpg
c6:burnt forest trees.aciklama: Regeneration on burnt heathland on Yew Tree Heath, New Forest. Controlled heath burning has been carried out on the area to the right of the picture, which is now turning green as new shoots emerge. The ponies come to graze on the new growth, one of the reasons for carrying out the burning in the first place. The mowed track on the left is presumably to help limit the extent of the burnt area. The heather on the extreme left of the picture has not been burnt recently.

c6:movie theater seating.aciklama: The former Roxy Theater in Winlock, Washington. Built in 1930 by Dr. W.W. Webb. Opened January 30, 1931 with a seating capacity of 350 and first playing the movie "Heads Up" starring Buddy Rogers and Helene Kane. It is currently a pinball museum.

The Minor Theater in Arcata, CA. Built by local capitalist Isaac Minor it was first known as Pettingills' Minor Theater, for the first operators. The $20,000 building was built of 1' reinforced concrete walls with a seating capacity of 600. Opened to much fanfare on December 3, 1914, it is still in use as a movie theater showing new releases.

Lamb meat of "kuzu çevirme" from Turkey.

Starter dish in Turkey with seafood, "topik", purslane salad etc. "Topik" is a hummus-like chickpea based meze from the cuisine of Istanbul, made especially by the Armenian community. The word etymology is "top" (TR) and "ik" from Armenian, making it a "small ball". Regrettably they had made it in a casserole, without giving the "ball" shape; taste was high above regular.

Cold dish "Şakşuka" from the Turkish cuisine, with eggplants, as the principal actor, and potatoes, green peppers "salça" (special tomato paste from Turkey), olive oil etc. It can be consumed as a "meze", an entrée (starter plate), or as a snack, or just for the sake of its delicious taste even if one is not hungry.
"Çiğ köfte" (lit. "raw meatballs") from the Turkish cuisine. Similar meze dishes may be found in other countries around Turkey.

c6:turkish meze and dishes.aciklama: "Ciğer kebap", "Ciğer kebabı", o "Ciğer şiş (kebap)" is skewer-grilled liver from the Turkish cuisine, a specialty of the south-eastern cuisine. (In Istanbul and the other large cities, liver is made at home as a "yahni" -stew or sautée with onions- or as "Arnavut ciğeri, a cold meze dish. At Edirne, the northwestern city in European Turkey, liver is cut in large flakes and deep-fried.) The art of Ikebana, or plant arrangements, combines story telling and decoration. The arrangement of the plants involves family history and standing with artistic arrangement.

The photograph was taken at Queens Garden Shepparton in 2025 by Albanian–Australian photographer Adrian Në Fokus. The group is dressed in traditional Tosk (southern Albanian) folk costume, featuring white fustanella skirts, red vests embroidered with the black double-headed eagle, and white felt caps (Qeleshe). The dancers perform in a circular formation

I made 60x40 in canvas prints of the drawing on a large format printer installed in my studio in Boston, MA. The drawing is a part of my current project “Of No Fixed Address”. The project will be on view at ArtSpace Maynard as a part of my solo exhibition at their gallery from February 27- April 5, 2019. Of No Fixed Address is a travelers tale. Dalam foto file:just focus on me.jpg, menggambarkan taman bunga hortensia yang berada pada area wisata Selecta Batu Malang. Fokus pada gambar tersebut adalah sebuah Hortensia yang berwarna biru yang disekelilingnya juga terdapat bunga hortensia lain dengan warna, merah, kuning, ungu, krem, dan putih yang sama indahnya meskipun tidak terlalu difokuskan. Dengan suhu yang cukup dingin dan pH tanah yang sesuai, tidak heran kalau bunga hortensia disini beraneka warna. Bunga hortensia biru yang saya p

Pulau Menjangan, yang terkenal akan habitat liar rusanya, menjadi suatu daya tarik tersendiri. Sebagai upaya menjaga kelestarian kawasan serta habitat alami pulau ini, pengunjung dilarang untuk memberikan makanan kepada satwa liar. Hal ini membuat kawanan rusa harus berjuang dalam kehidupannya; bergantung pada alam termasuk mencari makanan dan mempertahankan diri, terlihat dari tanduk seekor rusa pada foto ini yang tersisa sebelah saja.

The panel details its pre-dawn schedule, traditional barter practices, and regional delicacies like budbud and torta. On this 1-hour flight at sunrise you will experience the changing colors and the unique landscapes that scatter the region. Enjoy a unique hot air balloon flight over the fairy chimneys and rock cut churches. This exhilarating experience in Cappadocia is one of the best places around the world to fly with hot air balloons. www.britannica.com/place/Cappadoci

c6:burned restaurant building exterior.aciklama: Raleigh's, Cafe Intermezzo, Great China Restaurant, and now Chez Panisse. The list of Berkeley establishments damaged by fire in the last year and a half grows. Thankfully, the early morning blaze appears to have been largely contained by the restaurant's sprinkler system, resulting in somewhat limited burns to the front exterior of the building. With any luck, Berkeley-ites will resume chowing on their duck breast paillard and heirloom tomato gelée post haste. Coverage on Berkeleyside here.

c6:burned restaurant building exterior.aciklama: Gamla stan (The Old Town), is the old town of Stockholm, Sweden. Gamla stan consists primarily of the island Stadsholmen. Stortorget is the name of the scenic large square in the centre of Gamla Stan, which is surrounded by old merchants' houses including the Stockholm Stock Exchange Building.

By the mid 1870s, there were over thirty-two hotels when the population of Winnipeg was less than 8,000. The Woodbine Hotel origins date back to these early frontier days when it was known as Dufferin Hall. Built by Peter Sutherl

c6:structural fire damage restaurant.aciklama: 167-171 South Washington Street near Occidental Avenue South, Seattle, Washington, U.S., April 29, 1949. This is looking southeast by south. This was 16 days after the 1949 Olympia earthquake , which did considerable damage in this area; all of these buildings were eventually torn down due to structural damage. After roughly 60 years as a parking lot, this land eventually became the site of the new Weyerhaeuser headquarters in the 2010s.

c6:structural fire damage restaurant.aciklama: Thomas Franklin Schneider, architect of some 2,000 DC buildings, built the Cairo in 1894 near the edge of Washington City (Boundary Street -- Florida Avenue). The 1893 Transportation Building at the Chicago World's Fair inspired him. Originally the hotel had a ballroom, bowling alley, billiard room, coffee shop, and rooftop garden. It received water from an underground spring. Visitors to the rooftop frequently dropped pebbles to the street below, causing horses to give carriage riders the scare

c6:antalya voting.aciklama: Ruins of Pinara, ancient Lycian city in Asia Minor, close to Fethiye, Antalya Province, Turkey. September, 2025. Pinara, PinalePilleñni The city of Pinara is located on the eastern slopes of the South Antikragos Mountains (Baba Dağı) to the east of Fethiye Bay and overlooks the Xanthos Valley. It was built on terraces rising from 330 meters to 715 meters. It is bordered by the cities of Xanthos in the south and Tlos in the northeast. The Lycian name of the city was Pinale (or Pilleñni). Ancient

c6:modern tramway.aciklama: Ticknall Tramway tunnel: The tramway was built in 1802 by Benjamin Outram to connect the local limeworks to the Ashby Canal. The 140 yard long tunnel was constructed simply so as not to conflict with the driveway to Calke Abbey, and is of cut-and-cover build. This is the eastern tunnel mouth. The strengthening arches visible inside are under the driveway itself so as to be able to cater for modern vehicles. The tunnel is a Scheduled Monument. c6:modern tramway.aciklama: Tramway Museum, Crich This is car No 60 from Johannesburg. When it arrived in Crich, it had small metal plates which could be attached to the dash to show whether the car could be used by Whites only, or Non-Whites. These plates were not displayed on the car at Crich as they would be regarded as offensive in Britain, and indeed also in South Africa now. At the left is a modern Glasgow car, and behind on the right, one from Sheffield.

The building was expanded in 1965 with a matching addition, expanding the main hall of the landslide head house of the terminal to its present size. The building features a main front hall with a barrel-vaulted concrete roof, with standing seam metal exterior cladding, with four cross-barrel vaults, with one cross-vault dating to the original

c6:political party convention hall.aciklama: Title: Baltimore National Convention of Ratification. Clay and the tariff Abstract: A crude campaign badge produced for Whig National Convention held at Baltimore in May of 1844. There are two illustrations: above, a sailor with a hammer nails an American flag with the words "HENRY CLAY" to a ship's mast; below is a bust portrait of Clay in an ornamental frame, with the slogan "People's Candidate, Our Country's Hope." The image of the sailor with the flag was commonly used as a nativist emblem.

c6:alanya athletes.baslik: File:2023-02-25 01 SpaceX MEGAN - IMO 9591648 – Port Canaveral FL USA.jpg
c6:alanya athletes.aciklama: SpaceX Dragon recovery vessel, MEGAN - IMO 9591648, in the West Basin of Port Canaveral, Florida USA on February 25, 2023. Megan (previously named GO Searcher) is a SpaceX Dragon recovery vessel based at Port Canaveral, Florida. Alongside identical twin ship Shannon , both vessels are designed for Dragon capsule recovery operations. Shannon is named after Shannon Walker, the first female NASA astronaut to fly on SpaceX’s Dragon capsule during the Crew-1 mission. Megan is named after Megan McArth

c6:antalya stage.baslik: File:Marble statue depicting an ageing Trajan dressed in military cuirass, reworked in the 3rd century, from the theatre stage building at Perga, Antalya Museum (9646305072).jpg
c6:antalya stage.aciklama: The most important feature of this statue is that the head and the body of the statue were executed in different periods. The head with 2nd century features was carved again and was given a new appearance in accordance with 3rd century taste. The wig-like hair around the head, the beard, mustache, the pupils of the eyes and wrinkles on the forehead are the results of this 3rd century recarving. This method of recarving portraits at a later date was common during the restoration of the Perge thea

The Loggerhead Sea Turtle (Caretta caretta) is a sea turtle and the only member of the genus Caretta. The genus name "Caretta" is a latinization of the French "caret", meaning turtle, tortoise, or sea turtle. A loggerhead sea turtle reportedly grows up to 800 lbs (364 kg) and 3.5 feet (1.1 m) long. Their shell color is a reddish brown color, and the color of their skin is brown yellow.

Rose Atoll, part of American Samoa, is one of the most pristine wildlife refuges in the world and an essential sanctuary for endangered green sea turtles, or laumei ena’ena in Samoan. c6:antalya banner.aciklama: Termessos was a Pisidian city built at an altitude of more than 1000 meters at the south-west side of the mountain Solymos (modern day Güllük Dağı) in the Taurus Mountains (modern day Antalya province, Turkey). c6:new year lottery ticket.aciklama: Reverse of ‘A book instead of vodka’ ticket no. 005360, series 089. Rules cover selecting books through Gosizdat and consumer-cooperative shops, paying extra for more expensive books, postage paid by the society for prizes of at least five rubles, and a four-month redemption period. c6:sea turtle nesting sand.aciklama: Entalula Beach, located on Entalula Island within the Bacuit Archipelago of El Nido, Palawan, Philippines. Characterized by its fine white coralline sand and karst limestone cliffs, this pocket beach is part of the protected El Nido Marine Reserve. The surrounding marine habitat features high coral diversity and serves as a nesting area for various sea turtle species.

c6:sea turtle nesting sand.baslik: File:Diani Beach Shoreline - Kenya Kite Cup Spectator View.jpg
c6:sea turtle nesting sand.aciklama: A view of the shoreline during the competition days. The Kenya Kite Cup is famously held in aid of Diani Turtle Watch and the Local Ocean Conservation. Every kite seen in the sky represents a fundraising effort. The event uses the "spectacle" of kiting to educate the public and tourists about the endangered sea turtles (Green, Hawksbill, and Olive Ridley) that nest along this specific stretch of sand. The white sands seen here are vital nesting grounds that the community works to protect.

c6:mediterranean sea turtle conservation.aciklama: This Caretta caretta monument pays tribute to sea turtles! These emblematic species have roamed the Earth's Oceans for over 100 million years and are consider as indicator species for the marine environment. The monument was inaugurated on July 18th 2020 in Le Kram (Northern suburb of Tunisia) with the presence of local authorities, NGO’s and of course the people of the city. This initiative is part of the #SeaTuMedproject and is launched jointly with WWF Tunisia and Association de developpement

c6:pickleball game.aciklama: Sandy Pickle is a sport that was derived from pickleball, a modified version of the game for playing on grass or sand. Both Sandy Pickle and pickleball are played with standard pickleball paddles and balls, and while many of the rules are similar, the ball doesn't bounce on grass or sand. Some of the adjustments made in Sandy Pickle to accommodate for this include smaller boundaries, a higher net, and replacing the "kitchen" with a "no spike zone". Sure enough it was a flat tyre, and a classic nail puncture. He managed to do a roadside change (always a gamble with modern wheel nuts) and fit this bloody horrible space saver. The car looks ridiculous with one of these on! His small comfort was that getting the tyre off showed that the inner tread was worn to excess so the tyre needed replacement anyway.

c6:clay artifact museum display.aciklama: This significant Museum Zoomorphic Vessel Displayed Here presents a fascinating historical artifact. This open-bottomed smoke director or incense burner is crafted from clay tempered with materials like quartz, mica, and hornblende. Its highly stylized design features lizard and human head motifs, symbolizing the interconnectedness of humanity, nature, and the supernatural. Furthermore, the lizard motif is a prominent cultural symbol representing long life throughout the Philippines and Southeas

c6:green book close up.aciklama: The honey bee. Its fuzzy soft under abdomen. You are looking at the lapping zone between the sternites and the tergites. Each plate is relatively rigid, but in concert they make the abdomen quite bendable while at the same time more or less protecting the super soft innards. This doesn't always work and crafty parasites can find their way in there sometimes. c6:mediterranean resort turkey.baslik: File:Agora of Side - Antalya Province, Turkey - 12 June 2015.jpg
c6:mediterranean resort turkey.aciklama: Side is an ancient Greek city on the southern Mediterranean coast of Turkey, a resort town and one of the best-known classical sites in the country. It lies near Manavgat and the village of Selimiye, 78 km from Antalya in the province of Antalya. It is located on the eastern part of the Pamphylian coast, which lies about 20 km east of the mouth of the Eurymedon River. Today, as in antiquity, the ancient city is situated on a small north-south peninsula about 1 km long and 400 m across.

c6:turkish mosque interior.aciklama: Interior view of the main domes of the Blue Mosque , Istanbul , Turkey. The officially known as Sultan Ahmed Mosque is one of the most iconic and popular monuments of Ottoman architecture. It was constructed between 1609 and 1617 during the rule of Ahmed I and remains a functioning mosque today. It is decorated with thousands of Iznik tiles and painted floral motifs in predominantly blue colours, which give the mosque its popular name. The Blue Mosque, included in the UNESCO World Heritage Site

c6:environmental technology display.aciklama: Capacitance signals from a touch sensing capacitance array, are very small and are influenced by a wide range of environmental factors , some of which may be larger than the touch signal to be detected. Many of these factors, such as temperature and humidity, are global and so affect the whole array. Others, like dirt build up, may be local, slow and long lasting . In order to distinguish a finger touch from amongst these other variable, some simple form of Artificial Intelligence is required .

c6:kaş bay.aciklama: Macromolecules, mostly of protein nature, that function as (bio)catalysts by increasing the reaction rates. In general, an enzyme catalyses only one reaction type (reaction specificity) and operates on only one type of substrate (substrate specificity). Substrate molecules are attacked at the same site (regiospecificity) and only one or preferentially one of the enantiomers of chiral substrates or of racemic mixtures is attacked (stereospecificity).

A mixture of highly classic calligraphy, Ottoman ‘kalem işi’ work (the outer border) and 1970s slightly psychedelic background patterns. Demirciler Cami (Smiths’ Mosque) from 1861. The mosque has been restored in 2003; amongst other things, the old outer walls were doubled by a row of new stones. It has a minaret in Syrian style; in Turkey, this is called a ‘çardak minare’ (pergola minaret).

c6:health checkup close up.aciklama: The Perseverance rover relies on the successful design of the Mars Science Laboratory rover, Curiosity. However, Perseverance has a new science and technology toolbox. An important difference is that this rover can sample and cache minerals. To do so, Perseverance has a new coring drill to collect samples. The samples are then sealed in tubes and placed on the surface of Mars. In the future, another space mission could potentially pick up the samples and bring them to Earth for detailed analysis

Maxton Church and Graveyard. This mid 18th century rectangular church with portions of 17th century work was renovated in 1812 and 1866. It carries a Burgerhuys bell of 1609. See 606483 . A medieval church was first recorded here in the late twelfth century. (Source: Borders and Berwick, An Architectural Guide by Charles Alexander Strang).

c6:modern courthouse exterior.aciklama: Photograph of the Franklin County courthouse, built at a cost of about a half-million dollars. The exterior is of gray sandstone with polished granite columns at the entrances, and is surmounted by a clock tower. In the rear of the Court House and facing on Fulton street, is a modern stone fire-proof jail. This was Franklin County's fourth courthouse. It was dedicated on July 13, 1887. The building was razed in 1974.

c6:book pages interior shot.aciklama: Palamuse Parish School's classroom. This 19th century classroom is now a part of a museum that bears the name of writer Oskar Luts , who studied there and wrote the book Kevade about his schooldays. It remains his best know work and the film adaption of the novel (that was also shot in Palamuse) is regarded as the best Estonian film in the 20th century.

c6:students planting saplings.aciklama: A group of five students pose beside a slender sapling, surrounded by a neat circle of dark mulch. A group of Mather High School students stands beside a newly-mulched sapling at Glenmont Estate. The tenth grade class worked with the Olmsted Center for Landscape Preservation and Thomas Edison National Historical Park to build landscape preservation skills through actions like tree planting. The surface of the lake, whose height is 1217 meters, is 4.5 hectares and its circumference is about 1300 meters. The view of the lake, which is covered with pine, fir, beech, hornbeam and mixed species of trees, is wonderful in every season. On the edge of the lake, which is covered with the extraordinary beauty of nature, there is a cute building, which is the "State Guesthouse" of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

c6:ministry of agriculture and forestry.aciklama: Basalt column formations near the sea that was formed by volcanic activity in the region. Cooling of the lava created rectangular, pentagonal and hexagonal shaped columns.It is located in the city of Bartın, near the Güzelcehisar village. Similar formations can be seen in Northern Ireland, Scotland and California. In Turkey this is one of the few formations and it was designated as a natural monument by the Turkish Agriculture and Forestry Ministry in 2017.

c6:traffic restriction sign street.aciklama: An upside-down No Left Turn sign along southbound North Meyer Avenue in Tucson, Arizona, United States, appears to indicate that opposing (northbound) traffic may not turn left at West Washington Street. However, neither can southbound traffic turn right at this intersection, because West Washington Street is a one-way street going to the left. This No Left Turn sign was bolted on upside down to indicate No Right Turn, replacing a less confusing one-way sign that was bolted right-side up.

Built by the Fire Brigade Branch of the London County Council Architects Department. Extension to NE with drill tower added late C20. c6:the land of legends lights.aciklama: تْبِلِيسِي كما تُعرف باسم تفليس هي عاصمة جورجيا وأكبر مدنها تقع علي ضفاف نهر كورا ويبلغ عدد سكانها حوالي 1,500,000 نسمة . تأسست في القرن الخامس من قبل فاختانغ الأول غورغاسالي، ملك مملكة ايبيريا، تبليسي منذ ذلك الحين أصبحت عاصمة لمختلف الممالك والجمهوريات الجورجية. وبين ال1801 وال1917 ، عندما كانت تحت حكم الإمبراطورية الروسية السابقة، كانت تبليسي مقرا للحاكم الإمبراطوري، الذي يحكم كلا من جنوب وشمال القوقاز.

c6:turkish government office interior.aciklama: Interior view of the glass ceiling of the courtyard of the Postal Palace , Mexico City (Mexico). The building was built at the beginning of the 20th century, when the Post Office became a separate government entity in Mexico. Its design and construction back then was the most modern of the time. In the 1950s, the building was modified and its structure was affected, so when the 1985 earthquake struck Mexico City , this building was heavily damaged, undergoing restoration works in the 1990s.

c6:community breakfast plates.aciklama: South African Sketches. Plate III. Breakfast Party of Kaffir Marauders detected Print of a Breakfast Party of Kaffir Marauders by Charles Davidson Bell. Bell sketched a number of ethnographic studies of the different non-European South Africans while on an expedition into the Interior with Dr Andrew Smith in 1834. The sketches were laden with the colonialists views and opinions on each ethnic group. 'Malays' were seen as elegant and graceful; 'Hottentots' (Khoikhoi) as uncouth; 'Kaffirs' (Xhosa)

c6:urban planning map display.aciklama: This retouched map shows a concept from local governance in Seoul, which is called 'Neighborhood Region' (권역생활권), meaning an inter-district neighborhood unit which is literally a set having autonomous districts as components. It was first introduced to official urban planning of Seoul (서울도시기본계획) in 1997 as a concept of wide-range community planning, and continued to present days including Seoul Metropolitan Government's latest official urban plan published in 2023.

c6:lithium battery processing.aciklama: This image comes from my unpublished work on lithium–sulfur battery testing and represents a quiet moment inside an active research process. Beyond its technical function, the photograph reveals the hidden beauty of experimental science and the precision behind future energy technologies. I hope it can serve not only as documentation, but also as a meaningful visual bridge that helps others understand, appreciate, and engage with the ongoing development of advanced batteries.

O método de processamento começa com a extração de salmoura rica em lítio a partir de campos perfurados no salar. A salmoura é então transferida para uma série de tanques de evaporação que utilizam radiação solar e vento para evaporação e concentração, juntamente com um processo de precipitação para remover impurezas. A salmoura concentrada é então adicionada ao vege

The Atacama Desert in Chile is on the driest place on Earth. Within this arid environment lies a salt flat, or playa, named Salar de Atacama. With an extension of about 3000 km2, the Salar de Atacama is the largest salt flat of Chile and one of the largest active sources of lithium of the world. Lithium is used for the manufacturing of batteries, and the increasing demand has significantly increased its value in recent years – especially for the production of electric-car batteries. The refurbishment involved erecting pink- granite columns at the points of the star that encompasses the memorial. Four of these have a placard in English and Turkish telling some of the story of the relationship between the countries and the relationship with Atatürk. Flowers and wreaths were those laid on ANZAC

c6:quiet street in front of hospital.aciklama: The area where a market square was created between Fischerinsel and Leipziger Straße after the demolition of the fortifications on the west bank of the Spree in the 18th century was still a quiet, nameless square in front of the Gertraudentor in the 14th century. From around 1750, it was called Spittelmarkt, derived from Gertraudenhospital: Hospital - Spital - Spittel. Over the course of history, the market has disappeared, and the entire square is no longer recognizable.

c6:turkish mosque at night.aciklama: Melike Hatun Mosque , Ankara, Turkey. The mosque is named after Melike Hatun, probably the daughter of Kayqubad III, the Anatolian Seljuks sultan (r. 1298–1302). It's located in the old quarter of Ankara, popularly known as Hergele Meydanı. The ground area of the mosque is 3,600 m2 (39,000 sq ft) and it has enough room for 7000 prayers. The diameter of the dome is 27 m (89 ft) and the maximum height is 47 m (154 ft).

c6:turkish mosque interior night.aciklama: The Sultan Ahmed Mosque (Turkish: Sultanahmet Camii) is an historical mosque in Istanbul. The mosque is popularly known as the Blue Mosque for the blue tiles adorning the walls of its interior. It was built from 1609 to 1616, during the rule of Ahmed I. Like many other mosques, it also comprises a tomb of the founder, a madrasah and a hospice. While still used as a mosque, the Sultan Ahmed Mosque has also become a popular tourist attraction. [Wikipedia.org]

Tokatlıyan Hotel, located in Beyoğlu on İstiklal Street, was opened in 1897 by Mıgırdiç Tokatlıyan, an Armenian who had moved from Tokat to İstanbul. The building was designed by architect Alexander Vallaury. Originally named Hotel Splendide, the institution later took the name M. Tokatlıyan. During the 1920s this hotel was the second most important in the city after the famous Pera Palace. In 1946 it was sold and took the name Konak.

c6:antalya resort exterior.baslik: File:Roman theatre - Side - Antalya Province, Turkey - 8 June 2015.jpg
c6:antalya resort exterior.aciklama: Side is an ancient Greek city on the southern Mediterranean coast of Turkey, a resort town and one of the best-known classical sites in the country. It lies near Manavgat and the village of Selimiye, 78 km from Antalya in the province of Antalya. It is located on the eastern part of the Pamphylian coast, which lies about 20 km east of the mouth of the Eurymedon River. Today, as in antiquity, the ancient city is situated on a small north-south peninsula about 1 km long and 400 m across.
c6:antalya resort exterior.nesne: Roman theatre - Side - Antalya Province, Turkey - 8 June 2015

c6:smartphone social media.aciklama: Practice OPSEC while online, on the phone, or while spending leisure time in social settings, because the adversary could be watching and listening to every word. The internet is at our fingertips with the widespread use of internet-enabled devices such as smartphones and tablets. Make sure that the medium chosen to communicate is secure. Complacency and apathy toward scams in social engineering, phishing and fake accounts are just some examples that lax security leads to poor security.

c6:quran book on table.aciklama: Haft Sin! For Persian New Year, people make their table like this which is called 7 Sin. Sin(س) is one of the Persian alphabets. Usually people put 7 things that their name starts with س such as: •Apple (Sib سیب) as a symbol of beauty, •Coin (Sekeh سکه) as a symbol of wealth, •Vinegar(Serkeh سرکه) as a symbol of patient and long life, •Garlic(Sir سیر) as a symbol of healthiness, •Greenery(Sabzeh سبزه) as a symbol of new born, •Mämmi (Samanooسمنو) as a symbol of blessing and abundance, •Oleaster

cf:File:Once upon a time, the Fisherman'.aciklama: This photo was taken by me in the Summer of 1981. At the time, this antique fisherman's warf was surrounded by the ruins of the ancient walls from the roman era dated back to 100 BC . This place was used to be the part of the Apollon Temple in Side, Turkey. It is hearthbreaking to see how it looks today. (Geography 36°45'54.7"N 31°23'09.1"E)

c6:modern farming crops.baslik: File:Modern Farming- Agriculture in Britain, 1943 D15988.jpg
c6:modern farming crops.aciklama: Modern Farming- Agriculture in Britain, 1943 Agricultural workers operate a tractor-drawn 'Cutlift' machine in a clover field in Hampshire. This machine can be used to cut any green crop. Once cut, the crop passes up the conveyor and is dropped into the trailer. It can then be taken to a silo and be used as cattle feed. This machine is very useful because it means that entire fields can be cleared rapidly.

c6:storm clouds turkey.aciklama: An astronaut aboard the International Space Station took this photograph of a thunderstorm at night over western Türkiye. The image highlights two distinct lightning flash areas, one southeast of the city of İzmir and the other north of Aliağa. Using a camera’s time-lapse function and the proper shutter speed, astronauts can capture photos of the bright flashes amidst the clouds while simultaneously documenting nearby nighttime lights from cities and highways. The image’s high spatial resolution

c6:antalya ancient city.aciklama: Aspen dos, present-day Turkey, is known for having the best-preserved theatre of antiquity. With a diametre of 96 metres (315 ft), the theatre provided seating for 7,000. The theatre was built in 155 AD by the Greek architect Zenon, a native of the city, during the rule of Marcus Aurelius. It was periodically repaired by the Seljuqs, who used it as a caravansary, and in the 13th century the stage building was converted into a palace by the Seljuqs of Rum. cf:File:Sillyon Kent Kapısı.jpg.aciklama: Sillyon’un ana kent kapısı, antik şehrin savunma sisteminin en önemli parçasıdır. Yaklaşık M.Ö. 4. yüzyıla tarihlenen bu kapı, Hellenistik Dönem'de inşa edilen ve Roma ile Bizans dönemlerinde onarılan sur hattına entegredir. Konum: Güneydoğu yamacında, şehre ulaşan ana yolun sonunda yer alır. Mimari: Kesme taş bloklarla inşa edilmiştir. Duvar kalınlığı ortalama 1.8–2 metreyi bulur. Savunma Detayı: Ana kapının hemen arkasında z-kıvrımlı geçiş yer alır; bu, saldırılara karşı savunmayı kolaylaştırı

c6:modern neighborhood office building.aciklama: The former President's Office at George Washington University is now used by the George Washington University Law School . The two rowhouses on the corner of 20th and G Streets NW in the Foggy Bottom neighborhood of Washington, D.C., were built in 1892 and designed by George S. Cooper (700 20th Street NW) and Victor Mindeleff (2003 G Street NW). The adjoining buildings are modern additions constructed to look similar to the corner houses. The corner rowhouses are listed on the National Register

Former County House. Built in 1731 and 1732 Baroque style. Planned by András Petz. Extended on 1881. Ceremonial hall (wing) built in 1931. North city wall remains at courtyard. Listed. Now, Pécs Modern Hungarian Gallery, partly Janus Pannonius Museum Fine Arts and Applied Art Department office building, temporarly? the land registry was here. Around 2010 extended with a modern glass building/wing - 5 Papnövelde Street, Belváros (Inner City) neighborhood, Pécs , Baranya County , Hungary .

c6:empty council chamber.aciklama: A medieval lead pilgrims ampulla. Only the lower half remains, after having been apparently cut in half with a knife in antiquity in order to empty the contents. The chamber has a very feint criss-cross motif one one side; the other side is extensively damaged. A small side lug survives at the top on one side.

c6:empty council chamber.aciklama: An incomplete medieval lead pilgrim's ampulla. The neck is mostly missing apart from a small tab or lead at one side. The edges of the neck are patinated and appear to have been 'torn' or cut in antiquity, presumably in order to empty the contents. The chamber is circular and decorated on one side with a crowned and hatched heart, and on the other side with a four-petalled flower.

c6:children in town hall.aciklama: George Albert Rodman, originally from Ulverstone, built the 1923 Hall in Derby in the early 1900s. Married to Ada, they had nine surviving children out of 11. He constructed the hall for £1,200, allocating £300 for furniture. Opening on July 12, 1923, the event drew over 350 attendees, featuring musical performances by the Branxholm Orchestra. Rodman passed away in Scottsdale in 1962 at the age of 87.

cf:File:Kaleiçi (7972794074).jpg.aciklama: Kaleiçi is the historic city center of Antalya, Turkey. Until modern times, almost the entire city was confined within its walls. It has structures dating from the Roman, Byzantine, Seljuk, Ottoman and modern Turkish republican eras. The Kaleiçi area is located in the centre-eastern portion of the city along the mediterranean coast fronted by the yacht harbour that dates to the Roman era. The name Kaleiçi means "Inside the Kale" or "Inner Kale" (Kale itself means castle or fortress).

cf:File:Antalya Iskele Mescidi 4777.jpg.aciklama: The Iskele Kasjid (Mosque) was built by Bedirhan Paşazadelerden Kenan Paşa, governour of Teke. It is hexagonal in plan, made of cut stone and stands on six pillars, with a pyramidal tile covered roof. There is a wooden minaret aat the northwestern side. A source of clean water at the bottom of the masjid has been active in the formation of the architectural form. Text of notice at sight. In Turkish it is added the prayer room dates from 1903. It is in the harbour area.

c6:soil testing drill rig.aciklama: Geoquip Marine's "Geoquip Saentis" enters Dun Laoghaire harbour. Formerly the Ex-Toisa Vigilant, it was converted in Cammell Laird with a drilling rig for offshore geotechnical operations, down to a depth of 1000 meters, complete with soil testing lab. It began drill tests in Dundalk Bay in March 2020 & now is surveying potential for a new wind farm in Arklow Bank.

c6:geotechnical drilling site.aciklama: Meghan Riehl, a Savannah Corps geologist, takes a groundwater reading of soil material at a site near Fort Jackson, South Carolina Jan. 26. c6:cemetery.baslik: File:Bad Rappenau - Heinsheim - jüdischer Friedhof - Blick über Ostmauer bei Sonnenuntergang.jpg
c6:cemetery.aciklama: The old Jewish cemetery near Heinsheim, Bad Rappenau , Germany. This cemetery was established in the 16th century and is one of the largest and best preserved Jewish cemeteries in south-west Germany. The photo shows the view over the eastern enclosure wall to the first row of gravestones, which date from the late 18th/early 19th century. The photo was taken on an autumn evening shortly before sunset, hence the saturated, but somewhat subdued colours.

c6:biological pest control leaf.aciklama: The palearctic ground-weevil Coniocleonus nigrosuturatus feeding on the leaf of common ragweed (Ambrosia artemisiifolia). Common ragweed is the most dangerous weed species in Central-Europe, it couses human illness with its highly allergic pollen, and serious problems in the arable lands as arable weed. In Europe only few species can eat ragweed. This species (Coniocleonus nigrosuturatus) is able to eat the weed in laboratory conditions, and we don't know this species as arable pest.

c6:government building facade turkey.aciklama: Saint Isaac's Cathedral at night. t is also called Isaakievskiy Sobor and is the largest cathedral in the city of St. Petersburg and was the largest church in Russia when it was built (101.5 meters high). It is dedicated to Saint Isaac of Dalmatia, a patron saint of Peter the Great who had been born on the feast day of that saint. The cathedral took 40 years to construct, from 1818 to 1858. Under the Soviet government, the building was abandoned, then turned into a museum of atheism.

c6:working students turkey.aciklama: Entire roasted chicken in Ankara. In Turkey, roasted chicken is served, generally, in halves; but there are working class or student restaurants which may also serve it in pieces (drumstick etc) or "quarter"s. People, especially in weekends, like to take home an entire one to eat without home-cooking. Generally they sell it with rice ("pilav"), salad and "pide" (flatbread) in restaurants or specialized cooking points. If not, you make your own salad etc.

c6:modern interior design office.aciklama: Interior view of the glass ceiling of the courtyard of the Postal Palace , Mexico City (Mexico). The building was built at the beginning of the 20th century, when the Post Office became a separate government entity in Mexico. Its design and construction back then was the most modern of the time. In the 1950s, the building was modified and its structure was affected, so when the 1985 earthquake struck Mexico City , this building was heavily damaged, undergoing restoration works in the 1990s.
c6:modern interior design office.nesne: Palacio Postal, México D.F., México, 2013-10-16, DD 59

This is one of the pictures I took.

Our Milky Way continues to form the equivalent of one Sun every year. But in the past, that rate was up to 100 times greater. Located in the Large Magellanic Cloud galaxy, it’s the largest and brightest star-forming region near our own galaxy, plus home to the hottest, most massive stars known. c6:telescope looking at stars.aciklama: Like ancient explorers who looked to the stars to guide them to new worlds, astronomers today use stars to discover worlds many light years beyond our solar system. By studying stars and their unique influence, we can learn a great deal about their worlds – even their potential to sustain life as we know it.

c6:telescope looking at stars.baslik: File:Interferometric observations- fringes from two stars of different angular size (eso0111d).tiff
c6:telescope looking at stars.aciklama: Demonstrates in a schematic way, how the images of two stars of different angular size (left) will look like, with a single telescope (middle) and with an interferometer like the VLTI (right). Whereas there is little difference with one telescope, the fringe patterns at the interferometer are quite different. Conversely, the appearance of this pattern provides a measure of the star's angular diameter.

c6:stray animal welfare sign.aciklama: Hull Animal Welfare Trust, South Cave , East Riding of Yorkshire , England. This shows the entrance and main reception area of Hull Animal Welfare Trust, an animal rescue centre staffed almost entirely by volunteers and located down Pinfold Lane, South Cave, beside the busy A63. The charitable organisation accepts stray or abandoned animals with a view to rehoming them - the usual "lodgers" are dogs, cats and rabbits but various reptiles, rodents and birds have also been accommodated!

c6:ankara money.aciklama: The Square had been named as Taşhan Square, National Sovereignty Square, Public Square and finally Ulus Square. Starting from the Ulus Square, the Republic Boulevard reaches to Ankara Railway Station. The Victory Monument located in the Square was constructed with the money collected through a campaign initiated by the journal named Yenigün (New Day) published by Yunus Nadi in Ankara. The project of the Austrian artist Heinrich Krippel was selected as the top project in the international contest

c6:ankara turkish liras.aciklama: The building of General Directorate of Ziraat Bank was designed by Italian architect Guilio Mongeri and built between 1926 and 1929. Previously, the site was home to the two-storey building of Düyun-u Umuniye (Ottoman Public Debt Administration). During the Turkish War of Independence the building was used by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. cf:File:Yivli Minaret Mosque Antalya.jpg.aciklama: Yivli Minare Camii (Fluted Minaret Mosque) is a historical mosque in Antalya. The mosque's fluted minaret, which is decorated with dark blue tiles, is a landmark and symbol of the city. Built in 1230 and fully reconstructed in 1373, the minaret is 38 metres (125 ft) high, built on a square stone base, with eight fluted sections and has 90 steps to the top.

cf:File:Antalya Clock Tower in 2012 01.j.aciklama: The Clock Tower was built at the end of the l9th century. It has a square-plan, is made of rough and hewn stone and was placed on top of a surviving tower of the ancient (Roman) walls surrounding the city. The Roman tower provided a saving in building expenses, as well as an inspiration for the architectural style to be used.

cf:File:Antalya Old Town building ın 201.aciklama: I have visited the town 13 times for over a quarter of a century. So I saw a lot of change. This is one of the pictures I took. The older ones are scanned from slides.

c6:fluted minaret.aciklama: The close-up perspective captures a highly decorative intermediate gallery wrapping around one of the iconic fluted minarets. The structure features a series of open pointed arches, an intricate geometric balustrade pattern, and rows of closely spaced decorative stone corbel supports catching the warm evening light.
c6:fluted minaret.nesne: Charminar - A fluted minaret features an octagonal balcony with open pointed arches

c6:fluted minaret.baslik: File:Charminar - A towering fluted minaret rises into the sky showing multi-layered arched balconies.jpg
c6:fluted minaret.aciklama: The vertical perspective captures the upper sections of the iconic stone structure isolated against a clear blue sky. The architectural layout highlights two levels of decorative open-arched galleries supported by closely spaced corbel brackets and topped with a bulbous dome cupola.
c6:fluted minaret.nesne: Charminar - A towering fluted minaret rises into the sky showing multi-layered arched balconies

c6:social project group discussion.aciklama: In the Computational Social Science of Emerging Realities Group, we study identity using social media data. Specifically, we have examined the text of Twitter profile bios to reveal trends in identity change. Here we describe the rapidly growing prevalence of "pronoun-slash-lists" within Twitter bios of US users. c6:escaped lion close up.aciklama: If you've ever heard a domestic cat growl angrily when another cat sneaks up while he’s eating dinner, then watch this video. Imagine that scary growl multiplied by 1000! (Make sure your volume is up). In this case, P-65 and P-78 were able to "tolerate" one another while feeding on a deer the night before P-78, a young male mountain lion, was captured and had a GPS radio-collar placed on him back in December 2019. Since then, P-78 has been quite the traveler, successfully crossing major freeways

cf:File:Lycian city of the dead carved i.aciklama: Though archaeologists rank the exquisite necropolises at Myra as classics of Lycian culture, the site’s most beautiful elements are some of its touching, humanizing details. Dating back to the 4th century BCE, the rock-cut tombs line the hills above Myra’s famed theater and the Church of St. Nicholas. c6:leather office armchair.aciklama: Louis XV style armchair, caned, with leather seat

Rectangular back. Flat padded arms curve outward and are supported by their turned stumps which are in one with the front legs, similarly turned. Bowed front and side seat rails received by rosetted reserves. Rear legs square and tapered. Upholstery is black leather nailed to frame.

Bow-shaped joined crest rail above similarly shaped shoulders, over a back support of twisting horns. Similarly composed arm supports, centering a leather upholstered seat on four twisting cow-horn legs terminating in brass claw-and-glass ball feet. The front feet enclose opposing twisting horn returns. Part of group with ottoman 1986-39-2.

Upholstered seat and back with decorative brass nail heads, incised decoration on wood frame, the seat supported on diagonal front legs reinforced by a turned stretcher, slightly splayed back legs rise to seat back.

c6:antalya state theatre.baslik: File:Marble statue depicting an ageing Trajan dressed in military cuirass, reworked in the 3rd century, from the theatre stage building at Perga, Antalya Museum (9646305072).jpg
c6:antalya state theatre.aciklama: The most important feature of this statue is that the head and the body of the statue were executed in different periods. The head with 2nd century features was carved again and was given a new appearance in accordance with 3rd century taste. The wig-like hair around the head, the beard, mustache, the pupils of the eyes and wrinkles on the forehead are the results of this 3rd century recarving. c6:antalya state theatre.aciklama: This statue is of particular importance because the head and the body of the statue are from different periods. The head, dating from the 2nd century AD, has been recarved in a style suitable to 3rd century taste with the emperor being given a new image. The 3rd century carvers made changes to the hair, which is like a wig, as well as changes to the beard, mustache, pupils and carved wrinkles on the forehead. c6:health complex building.aciklama: Domo, Oomoto's health food store in Kameoka, located directly across the street from Ten'on-kyo (Oomoto's administrative headquarters complex). This is one of, if not the only, building in Japan with permanent monolingual Esperanto signage on the building itself. "Domo" means 'house' in Esperanto. Translation of the Esperanto signage: "House: The world should be a home for every living being".
